title: ABIOS: Token-Aware Shared-State Messaging for Agent-to-Agent Communication
description: Tokenizer-aware wire encodings and honest decoder-setup benchmarks for multi-message agent command streams (ABIOS/3), including reproducible o200k_base accounting against compact JSON, English, TOON, and Agora-style baselines. Negative results for SYM-2P v1 JSON packets and superseded SYM-2P v2 dense pilots are included. Reference implementation under scripts/protean-abios/; normative SPEC-ABIOS-3.md; Synbios forge schema is an example profile. Not peer reviewed.
notes: Set version at deposit time; do not rely on a fixed version field in this file. Paper source: paper/abios.md. Benchmark: make bench.
